setting.description: The Data folder of a Korean MapleStory2 client, the one whose item data is in bundles (Xml.m2d holds itemdata/*.xml). It is only read. Empty = the environment variable MS2_CLIENT_DATA. Leave it empty when you have no such client.

The Data folder of a global (North America / Europe) MapleStory2 client, the one with one file per item (Xml.m2d holds item/...). It is only read. Empty = the environment variable MS2_GMS_CLIENT_DATA. Leave it empty when you have no such client.
The data folder of your local server (the one holding its Xml.m2d). It is only read. Empty = the environment variable MS2_SERVER_DATA.

Folder of mod folders (each with a mod.xml). Save mod writes here; Plan and Apply use the mods that are checked in the view's list, in its order (kept in modkit-mods.xml in this folder). Empty = the environment variable MS2_MODS.

Where Apply writes patched copies of the archives (client/ and server/ under it): the server's always, the client's when "Apply to" is the workspace. Empty = the environment variable MS2_MOD_WORKSPACE.

The folder of a COPY of your client that holds Data. With "Apply to: game folder", Apply writes the changed client tables there as plain files (Data/Xml/...), which the game reads before its archives; Revert removes exactly those files. Empty = the environment variable MS2_GAME_DIR.

Optional. After a successful Apply, every server archive the mods changed (the .m2d and its .m2h) is copied from the workspace into this folder, for example the data folder a server reads. The files it replaces are kept and put back by Revert. Plan names the folder before anything is written. Empty = the environment variable MS2_SERVER_TARGET; both empty = no copy.

Optional. The folder "modkit schema build" wrote (out/modkit/schema by default). When set, Plan and Apply check the mods against it as the command line does: a warning for an attribute or element the shipped table never has, and a note where schema-notes.xml says the client reads it. Empty = the environment variable MS2_MOD_SCHEMA; both empty = no check.

Locale and server type the Korean client runs with, as LOCALE/TYPE (NA/Dev, KR, /Dev). They decide which features are on. Empty = KR/Live. Also a field in the MS2 Tables view. MS2_CLIENT_FEATURES in the environment or in modtools.toml goes before it.
As above for the global client. Empty = NA/Live. MS2_GMS_CLIENT_FEATURES in the environment or in modtools.toml goes before it.
As above for the server: the locale and the server type its data import is run with. Empty = NA/Live. MS2_SERVER_FEATURES in the environment or in modtools.toml goes before it.

When an MS2 Mods view opens, the Game Solution and Output View panes are collapsed to their edge tabs (auto-hide), once per Toolbench session and only when they are docked and showing. Also in the menu MS2 Mods.
Off: Apply writes nothing while two mods conflict. On: Apply goes on, and where two mods set the same thing the mod higher in the mods list of the MS2 Tables view wins. Also a box under that list.

Optional. A command line that is run after a successful Apply or Revert, meant for a server's own import step. Plan shows the command before it runs; its output and exit code appear in the view's output box. {target} and {workspace} in the line stand for the two folders. Empty = the environment variable MS2_AFTER_APPLY; both empty = nothing is run.

action.label: Tables
action.tooltip: Shows the MS2 Tables view

action.label: Items
action.tooltip: Shows the MS2 Items view: one item across its files, with clone to a new id

action.label: NPCs
action.tooltip: Shows the MS2 NPCs view: one npc across its files and targets, with clone to a new id

action.label: Skills
action.tooltip: Shows the MS2 Skills view: one player skill or effect with its levels, motions and attacks on every target, with clone, job tree row and tooltip

action.label: Shops and Drops
action.tooltip: Shows the MS2 Shops and Drops view: one shop or drop box with its rows on every target, with clone and new under reserved ids

action.label: Recipes
action.tooltip: Shows the MS2 Recipes view: the gathering and crafting recipes of the life skills with their materials and results on the client and the server, with add and clone under reserved ids

action.label: Item options
action.tooltip: Shows the MS2 Item options view: the constant and static stat lines of items per option code and grade, on the kms client and the server's rows, with fork to a new code

action.label: Item sets
action.tooltip: Shows the MS2 Item sets view: the item sets with their items and set bonuses on the kms client and the server, with add and clone under reserved ids

action.label: Dungeons
action.tooltip: Shows the MS2 Dungeons view: the dungeon rooms with their maps, limits and rewards on the kms client and the server, with add and clone under reserved ids

action.label: Spawns
action.tooltip: Shows the MS2 Spawns view: what spawns at the spawn points of a map (tag, population, cool time), on the server and the kms client, with add, clone and remove

action.label: Global drops
action.tooltip: Shows the MS2 Global drops view: the server's global drop boxes and their item groups (item, levels, count range, weight, rarity), with add, clone and remove

action.label: Achievements
action.tooltip: Shows the MS2 Achievements view: the trophies (achieve/*.xml) with their texts, fields and grades (condition, reward), with clone into the mod's id range, remove and the plan checks

action.label: Quests
action.tooltip: Shows the MS2 Quests view: one quest on every target, with its level, NPCs, rewards, condition counts and texts, and clone to a new id

action.label: Dialogue
action.tooltip: Shows the MS2 Dialogue view: the talk of an NPC step by step on every target, with its pages, choices and jumps, the flow and the problems, and the quest talk of the quests it starts or completes

action.label: Triggers
action.tooltip: Shows the MS2 Triggers view: the trigger scripts of a map, each as a tree of its states with their conditions, actions and the states they go to

action.label: Text import
action.tooltip: Shows the MS2 Text import view: fills our string rows that are still Korean from the global client's string files, file by file, with the plainly different rows to choose by hand

action.label: Field rows
action.tooltip: Shows the MS2 Field rows view: the maps our client has but cannot open (no xblock in table/fielddata.xml), with the compact row built from the global client's map file, written into the mod

action.label: Maps
action.tooltip: Shows the MS2 Maps view: the entities of a map's files with their properties, and edits of them (set, unset, remove, restore) as map ops of the mod

action.label: Sound
action.tooltip: Shows the MS2 Sound view, read only: the music cues of Sound/MS2Sound.fev with the maps that play them, and the sound banks (MS2Sound_*.fsb) with their samples

action.label: Levels
action.tooltip: Shows the MS2 Levels view: the experience a level needs (table/nextexp.xml, on every client and the server alike) and the experience monsters give by level and kind (the server's monsterExpTable.xml), set, scaled or taken back into the mod

action.label: Constants
action.tooltip: Shows the MS2 Constants view: the game constants (table/constants.xml of every client and the server's pack, and the server's table/Server/constants.xml), each copy's value with the mod, set on every copy or one, or taken back into the mod

action.label: Attendance
action.tooltip: Shows the MS2 Attendance view: the server's login calendars (the AttendGift events of table/Server/NA/GameEvent.xml): the dates, the name and mail texts, the play time a day asks for and the item of each day, edited, added as new events or taken back into the mod

action.label: Meret Market
action.tooltip: Shows the MS2 Meret Market view: the server's cash shop (the items of table/Server/shop_merat_custom.xml): the item, tab, price, payment, sale times, jobs and levels of each sale and its bundles, edited, added as new sales, taken off sale or taken back into the mod

action.label: Fishing
action.tooltip: Shows the MS2 Fishing view: the server's fishing tables (fish, fishing spots, lures and the global and individual fish boxes of Server.m2d): each row's fields and a box's fish lines, edited, added as new rows or copies, removed or taken back into the mod, with the checks the server's reading asks for

action.label: Gacha
action.tooltip: Shows the MS2 Gacha view: the gacha capsules (table/gacha_info.xml) with their drop box, coin refund and window fields, the capsule items that open each one and the odds of its drop box, edited, added as new capsules or copies, removed or taken back into the mod, with the checks the server's reading asks for

action.label: Enchant
action.tooltip: Shows the MS2 Enchant view: the stat bonus an item gets per enchant level (table/Server/enchantOptionTable.xml), one ladder of +1 to +15 per item slot, rank and level band, with what an enchant to each level adds (for enchants done after the change: the server saves the bonus with the item), edited per grade, scaled, moved to other levels, extended or copied for other items, with the checks the server's lookup asks for

action.label: Plan
action.tooltip: Shows what the enabled mods of the mods folder (and the pending edits) would change, with conflicts and warnings; writes nothing

action.label: Apply
action.tooltip: Saves the mod being edited and writes what the enabled mods change: loose files into the game folder, or patched copies of the archives into the workspace folder

action.label: Revert
action.tooltip: Removes what Apply wrote: the loose files in the game folder and the patched copies in the workspace folder
